# CYLOGIC SOFTWARE – Official Digital Identity Hub

> Official multilingual profile hub of Cy Logic Software (CYLOGIC SOFTWARE), a technology company based in Gazimağusa (Famagusta), Northern Cyprus, building custom software, enterprise ERP systems, AI solutions, business automation and secure IT infrastructure for businesses in Northern Cyprus and Türkiye.

This GitHub Pages hub complements the company's primary website. For full, authoritative company content (services, products, projects, insights) use https://www.cylogicsoftware.com/ and its own llms.txt at https://www.cylogicsoftware.com/llms.txt.

## Hub pages

- [Türkçe](https://cylogicsoftware.github.io/cylogicsoftware-official/): Turkish (primary language)
- [English](https://cylogicsoftware.github.io/cylogicsoftware-official/en/): English
- [Русский](https://cylogicsoftware.github.io/cylogicsoftware-official/ru/): Russian
- [فارسی](https://cylogicsoftware.github.io/cylogicsoftware-official/fa/): Persian (RTL)

## Service areas

- Artificial intelligence: AI-powered business solutions, AI integration, AI assistants and agents, local LLM and RAG, AI reporting and data analysis
- ERP and enterprise software: custom ERP, financial management, accounting and reporting, inventory, HR and time & attendance, CRM and procurement
- Custom software development: enterprise web applications, React and TypeScript, database-driven systems, web/mobile/SaaS, B2B platforms
- Business automation and integration: process automation, API and system integrations, dashboards and BI
- IT and digital transformation: server and cloud infrastructure, backup and monitoring, cybersecurity, business digitalization
